## Duplicate check

<!--
This repo has repeatedly had the same one-line fix opened as 5+ separate PRs
because nobody checked for existing open work first (see issue #47). Before
submitting, confirm:
-->

- [ ] I searched open PRs (`state:open`) for existing work touching the same
      file(s) or root cause, and this isn't a duplicate.
- [ ] I searched open issues for an existing report of this problem. If one
      exists, this PR references it (`Closes #123` / `Refs #123`) instead of
      leaving a second, disconnected fix.
